The plate is a square plate of roughly 24 cm across. The food is two corn cob cross-section pieces, each about 4.5 cm in diameter and about 2.5 cm thick. One piece has a volume of roughly 40 cm³, but the cob core takes up part of that, so each weighs about 30 g, or about 60 g for both. Boiled corn on the cob is about 95 kcal/100 g (kernels run about 86–100).
